description: Committee recommends lowering TKN limit to 50 mg/L in sewer bylaw.
Industrial users would pay surcharges for TKN discharge from 2028.
This aims to protect environment and recover treatment costs.

chips.text: Recommended to Council
4 for, 0 against
Ammonia concentrations entering the plant increased 65% over the past decade.
Industrial users will face surcharges or invest in pre-treatment.
Operating outside permit levels risks fines from Water Security Agency.
Lowering TKN limits protects the receiving environment and fish.
Administration will report back in 2027 with final surcharge rates.

description: Council requested a report on localized air quality monitoring.
Report will focus on specific city areas and green infrastructure.
This aims to improve residents' quality of life.

chips.text: Approved
3 for, 1 against
Mayor Block stated the city would be doing "work that doesn't need to be done".
Residents in specific neighborhoods could see improved local air quality.
Staff stated no identified need for additional air quality monitoring beyond provincial efforts.
Mayor Block opposed, believing the city would be doing unnecessary work.
Motion aims for equity in air quality, focusing on areas with less green canopy.
Pilot program offers air quality sensors measuring PM 2.5, PM 10, temperature, and humidity.
Administration will provide a follow-up report on localized air quality monitoring.
